svg.text: The control plane builds, deploys and manages apps. The data plane serves users and systems: the apps, and the services they call.
Core · one Studio cluster per environment
The build pipeline pushes the app's image.
The deploy pipeline renders the app's release,
and publishes the gitops repository in Gitea
as the apps syncroot that Flux follows.
Runtime · per service owner and environment
One .NET project per app, in its own repository, built on the App backend and serving the App frontend.
Runs app process steps by calling
Most service owners use tt02 and prod. Only Studio prod deploys to prod.
